# Assumption of Moses Chapter 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Cosmic Theophany and Final Victory

---

**10:1** And then his kingdom shall be revealed in all his creation, and then the devil shall be brought to an end, and sorrow shall be removed with him.

**10:2** Then the messenger shall be filled, who has been placed in the highest place, appointed from the beginning.

**10:3** He will arise from his place at once and will avenge them of their enemies.

**10:4** For the Most High God will arise, the Eternal One alone, and he will appear to punish the nations and will destroy all their idols.

**10:5** Then, O Israel, you will be happy, and you will mount upon the neck and wings of the eagle.

**10:6** And they will be ended, and God will exalt you.

**10:7** And then you will look from on high and will see your enemies on the ground, and you will recognize them and rejoice.

**10:8** And you will give thanks and confess your Creator.

**10:9** And you, Joshua the son of Nun, keep these words and these books.

**10:10** For from my death and burial until his coming there will be two hundred and fifty times.

**10:11** This is the course of times which will pass until they are filled.

**10:12** I am going to my rest and my sleep with my fathers.

**10:13** But the Lord will comfort those who mourn and will render justice to those who are oppressed.

**10:14** And he will bring light to those who are in darkness, and he will deliver the poor from the hand of the enemy.

**10:15** And in those times there will arise those who call upon his name, and they will mourn and fast and pray.

**10:16** And he will hear them and will deliver them from their oppression.

**10:17** For the Lord of lords is a God of gods, and a great King, and he is the God of all creation.

**10:18** Blessed be the Lord God, the Lord and God of all ages.
